about: 화면을 사람처럼 써 보는 회귀 시험 — node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/trade-entry.json. QA 하네스 기본자료(QA-CUST·QA-SUPP·QA-WH·QA-PROD·QA-MAT)를 쓰고, 만든 전표는 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 판매입력 — 거래처·창고·품목을 코드도움으로 골라 저장하면 말 없이 빈 칸으로 돌아간다(원본 E040205 2026-10-21) — 번호는 API 로 찾는다
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const s = (await (await fetch('/api/sales', { headers: H })).json()).sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)[0]; sessionStorage.setItem('__lastSale', s.docNo); return s.docNo })()

shots.name: 구매입력 — 같은 흐름(QA-MAT 은 구매단가가 0 이라 단가를 직접 넣는다)
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const s = (await (await fetch('/api/purchases', { headers: H })).json()).sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)[0]; sessionStorage.setItem('__lastPurchase', s.docNo); return s.docNo })()

shots.name: 주문서 등록 — 거래처·품목을 코드도움으로(9회차까지 긴 드롭다운이었다)
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const o = (await (await fetch('/api/sales-orders', { headers: H })).json()).sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)[0]; sessionStorage.setItem('__lastSO', o.orderNo); return o.orderNo })()

shots.name: 판매입력 수정 창 — 일자 칸 잠김 · [Fn] 일자변경 → 새 날짜의 다음 번호(옛 번호 안 씀) · 안내 · 뒷정리
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:Promise.all(['/partners','/items','/warehouses'].map((p) => window.__api('GET', p))).then(([pa, it, wh]) => { const c = pa.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-CUST'), i = it.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-PROD'), w = wh.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-WH') ?? wh.body[0]; return window.__api('POST', '/sales', { saleDate: '2026-10-10', partnerId: c.id, warehouseId: w.id, remark: 'QA일자변경', lines: [{ itemId: i.id, quantity: 1, unitPrice: 1000 }] }) }).then((r) => { sessionStorage.setItem('__cd', r.body.id); sessionStorage.setItem('__cdNo', r.body.docNo); return r.status })

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(() => { const dlg = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="일자변경"]'); const el = dlg.querySelector('input[type=date]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, '2026-10-20'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true })()

js:(() => { const dlg = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="일자변경"]'); const b = [...dlg.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === '저장'); b.click(); return true })()

expect:window.__api('GET', '/sales').then((l) => { const x = l.body.find((y) => String(y.id) === sessionStorage.getItem('__cd')); sessionStorage.setItem('__cdNew', x.docNo); return /-20261020-\d{4}$/.test(x.docNo) && x.docNo !== sessionStorage.getItem('__cdNo') })
